rubric.why: Identifies that temporary magnets work in a magnetic field and lose their magnetic properties when it vanishes.
rubric.description: Temporary magnets work in the presence of a magnetic field and lose their magnetic properties when the field vanishes.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating the field-dependent nature of temporary magnets and their loss of magnetic properties when the field is removed.

rubric.why: Identifies that permanent magnets retain their magnetic properties.
rubric.description: Permanent magnets retain their magnetic properties forever.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that permanent magnets retain their magnetic properties.

modelAnswer: Temporary magnets are the magnets that work in the presence of a magnetic field of permanent magnets. Once the magnetic field vanishes, they lose their magnetic properties. Permanent magnets retain their magnetic properties forever.

rubric.why: Defines the magnetic field as a region around a magnet.
rubric.description: A magnetic field is the region around a magnet.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the region around a magnet.

rubric.why: States that another magnetic object experiences a force in that region.
rubric.description: Another magnetic object experiences a force in the region.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that a magnetic object experiences a force there.

modelAnswer: A magnetic field is the region around a magnet where an other magnetic object experiences a force on it.

rubric.why: Connects the lines to the path followed by the filings.
rubric.description: The lines correspond to the path of the filings.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the lines show or correspond to the path of the filings.

rubric.why: Names the lines as magnetic lines of force.
rubric.description: These lines are called magnetic lines of force.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for giving the correct name.

modelAnswer: This pattern can be better shown by lines that correspond to the path of the filings. These lines are called magnetic lines of force.

rubric.why: Gives a use of permanent magnets from the textbook answer.
rubric.description: Permanent magnets are used in electric motors, generators, moving-coil loudspeakers, or for separating iron objects from mixtures.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming permanent magnets and at least one of their uses.

rubric.why: Gives a use of electromagnets from the textbook answer.
rubric.description: Electromagnets are used in electric bells, magnetic relays, circuit breakers, telephone receivers, or electromagnetic cranes.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming electromagnets and at least one of their uses.

modelAnswer: Permanent magnets are used in electric motors, electric generators, moving coil loudspeakers, separating iron objects from different mixtures etc. Electromagnets are temporary magnets. They are used in electric bells, magnetic relays, circuit breakers, telephone receivers, electromagnetic cranes, etc.
